args.sql:
SELECT 
  a.market_sentiment_indicators -> 'flow' ->> 'smartforce' AS smart_trading_flow,
  a.market_sentiment_indicators -> 'big_players' ->> 'whalemotion' AS whale_driven_market_activity,
  m.quote_depth_snapshot -> 'metadata' ->> 'mktcombo' AS market_pair,
  ms.priceshiftday AS price_change_24h,
  ms.highspotday AS price_high_24h,
  ms.lowspotday AS price_low_24h,
  ms.vwapday AS average_price_24h
FROM 
  analyticsindicators AS a
  JOIN marketdata AS m ON a.mdataref = m.marketdatanode
  JOIN marketstats AS ms ON m.marketdatanode = ms.mdlink;
